correctness.rationale: There is an independent pathwise proof of the lower bound. Fix a common deterministic contact history. If a target is infected only with vaccination, take a causal chain x_0=s,...,x_l=target in that run, with x_j first infective in round j. None of these distinct vertices is the vaccine recipient. Let j be the first index where the unvaccinated infection time differs. The preceding vertex was infective in the same round in both runs and the shared contact succeeds, so x_j must have been infected earlier without vaccination; it cannot be the target. First-round infections of vertices other than the recipient coincide. Thus j cannot be 1 or 2: in the latter case an earlier unvaccinated infection would be in round 1. Therefore l>=j+1>=4, giving at least five distinct chain vertices plus the vaccinated vertex. A deterministic common-history argument implies the claim for the stated independent contacts. Separately, direct enumeration of relevant contact subsets with first-infective-time tuples reproduced 372 timed states, 140 paired SIR projections and zero adverse terminal states at n=5. Tracing the frozen witness confirms that its common intermediate meets the outgoing successful contact only in the vaccinated run. Finite duration makes each final risk a polynomial, so the strict difference at a cube vertex persists in a relative neighborhood containing interior points and an open neighborhood of such a point.
residual_risks: The bound assumes one infective seed, one initially vaccinated vertex, permanent removal and exactly one infectious round; it is about an individual third party and not any population-level outcome.

value.rationale: The boundary gives a precise limit on when calendar-time dependence can overturn a familiar individual-risk monotonicity theorem. The pathwise obstruction rules out every smaller graph under all contact schedules; a strict difference robust to probability perturbations is stronger than a degenerate isolated example. This is a meaningful minimal counterexample in the abstract model, not a clinical policy finding.
residual_risks: No interpretation as a statement about public-health benefit or harm in real populations.
